div.div: group by gemeente_code, versie collapses each run into one row; min(peiljaar) and max(peiljaar) become the range, and the open end is 9999-12-31 so a between-join needs no special case for the current version.

switch.text: group by gemeente_code, versie collapses each run into one row; min(peiljaar) and max(peiljaar) become the range, and the open end is 9999-12-31 so a between-join needs no special case for the current version.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1298px; height: 1px; padding-top: 580px; margin-left: 94px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #94a3b8;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #576476; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; font-style: italic; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: versienummer is row_number() over the periods, not versie itself: the running sum starts at 1 but is not guaranteed to be gap-free.
